brief.premise: The harbor warning light went dark at the worst moment. Find out who moved it before the tide comes in.
brief.tone: Quiet coastal mystery with an anxious but hopeful ending.
brief.canon: Oren moved the lamp to the storehouse after seawater cracked its lens. He rang the bell instead; the tide and signal records clear up the apparent theft.

locations.name: Low Tide Quay
locations.description: Lysa is listening to the harbor. A tide chart hangs beside the signal hut. Try inspecting the tide_chart.

locations.name: Signal Hut
locations.description: Oren watches the locked storehouse door. A release box has wave, star and shell marks.

locations.name: Lamp Storehouse
locations.description: The warning lamp rests on a workbench with a cracked lens. A signal_log lies beside it.

characters.name: Lysa
characters.voice: Brisk harbor runner. Short questions, quick observations.
characters.opening_reply: Lysa says, 'I heard the warning bell after the lamp went dark. The release-box rhyme is wave first, star next, shell last.'

characters.name: Oren
characters.voice: Careful signal keeper. Wants dates and times before he draws a conclusion.
characters.opening_question: How can I get to the storehouse?
characters.opening_reply: Oren says, 'Show me the tide chart and I can let you into the storehouse. Bring back the signal log if you want the full account.'

clues.title: The warning bell
clues.question: Did you hear a warning?
clues.text: Lysa heard the harbor warning bell after the lamp went dark.

clues.title: The tide chart
clues.text: The chart records a surge near the signal lamp just before the warning bell.

clues.title: The signal log
clues.text: Oren recorded a cracked lens, a move to the storehouse, and a bell warning in place of the lamp.

puzzles.success_reply: The release box clicks. You can now open the storehouse.

actions.message: The chart shows a surge reached the lamp just before the bell.
Oren checks the chart against his notes and unlocks the storehouse.
actions.blocked: Find the tide chart on the quay first.

actions.message: You pull the released bolt and open the storehouse.
actions.blocked: The release box is still locked.

actions.message: The log explains the cracked lens. Oren moved the lamp here and rang the bell instead.
Oren and Lysa reconcile the bell and lamp records. The replacement warning light is lit.
actions.blocked: Compare Lysa's account with the storehouse signal log before reporting.

art.alt: A harbor signal lamp and a timber quay under the moon.
Lysa wears a blue cap and a rust-red coat.
Oren wears a gold cap and a green coat.

puzzles.title: Harbor warning timeline
puzzles.prompt: Arrange the warning events from earliest to latest.
puzzles.success_reply: The timeline matches the harbor record. The release box clicks open.

location_descriptions.signal_hut: Oren watches the locked storehouse door. The release box asks you to put the harbor warning in order.

character_replies.lysa: Lysa says, 'The surge came first. Then the lamp went dark, and only then did I hear the warning bell.'
